items.headline: Patrick Mahomes remains on course toward Week 1, but final clearance is still unresolved
items.detail: Mahomes continues to target the Denver opener following ACL/LCL surgery and has progressed through camp work. NFL reporting still treats final Week 1 availability as a live medical decision rather than a guarantee.
items.bettingImpact: Major because the market is KC -3 while the structural model is near pick'em. A healthy Mahomes state must carry a materially different fair line than a limited-or-out state.
items.modelTreatment: Maintain scenario pricing and do not qualify DEN +3 until Mahomes' expected mobility/availability is explicitly represented.

items.headline: Atlanta Week 1 starter remains unresolved between Michael Penix Jr. and Tua Tagovailoa
items.detail: Penix is back in full team work, while the Falcons continue evaluating the competition under a new Kevin Stefanski staff.
items.bettingImpact: Material because the two quarterbacks require different efficiency, sack, mobility and injury assumptions.
items.modelTreatment: Keep separate Penix-start and Tua-start scenarios; PIT -3 versus current baseline PIT -4.4 remains monitor rather than bet.

items.headline: 49ers-Rams will be played at Melbourne Cricket Ground
items.detail: The divisional matchup is in Melbourne rather than Los Angeles, creating an extreme travel/time-zone environment for both teams.
items.bettingImpact: Requires neutral-site HFA and long-haul travel/rest treatment.
items.modelTreatment: Treat as neutral venue; do not assign a conventional Rams home edge.

items.headline: George Kittle activated from PUP but Week 1 Melbourne availability remains uncertain
items.detail: Kittle is practicing after Achilles rehab, but he and the club have acknowledged that the long Australia trip could factor into whether Week 1 is the right return date.
items.bettingImpact: Meaningful to San Francisco passing efficiency and red-zone offense; especially relevant with only ~2 points between model and market.
items.modelTreatment: Keep a Kittle-in/Kittle-out scenario until padded-practice and travel decision are known.

items.headline: Ashton Jeanty remains on the mend from an ankle injury
items.detail: Klint Kubiak said the Raiders have another week to assess Jeanty's Week 1 condition but are counting on him.
items.bettingImpact: Relevant to a run-centered Raiders offensive structure, though not nearly large enough by itself to explain the model/market side reversal.
items.modelTreatment: Maintain small workload uncertainty; the bigger correction remains Miami's offseason offensive reset.

items.headline: Breece Hall expected to be ready for Week 1 after groin injury
items.detail: The Jets expect Hall back for Tennessee following a two-to-three-week timeline.
items.bettingImpact: Reduces the probability of a meaningful Jets offensive downgrade at the current time.
items.modelTreatment: No direct Week 1 downgrade unless recovery timetable changes.

items.headline: Giants enter Week 1 build with multiple offseason injury concerns
items.detail: New York has dealt with significant summer injuries including season-ending losses and ongoing monitoring around key offensive personnel after a major roster transition.
items.bettingImpact: Works against blindly accepting a Giants-side model reversal versus Dallas.
items.modelTreatment: Require final 53-man roster and Week 1 practice participation before NYG +2.5 can progress beyond audit status.
